==Problem==
What is the value of this expression?

<cmath>\frac{\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}}{\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}}</cmath>

<cmath>\textbf{(A)} \hspace{3pt} \frac{4}{9} \hspace{19pt} \textbf{(B)} \hspace{3pt} \frac{2}{3} \hspace{19pt} \textbf{(C)} \hspace{3pt} 1 \hspace{19pt} \textbf{(D)} \hspace{3pt} \frac{3}{2} \hspace{19pt} \textbf{(E)} \hspace{3pt} \frac{9}{4}</cmath>

==Solution 1==

The inner square root cannot be negative. If the outer square root is negative, the denominator is also negative, resulting in a positive fraction, an identity. Thus, we only consider positive squares, in which the numerator simplifies to <imath> \sqrt{16 \cdot 9} = \sqrt{16}\sqrt{9} = 4 \cdot 3 = 12 </imath>, and the denominator simplifies to <imath> \sqrt{81 \cdot 4} = \sqrt{81}\sqrt{4} = 9 \cdot 2 = 18 </imath>. The answer is <imath> \frac{12}{18} = \frac{4}{6} = \boxed{\frac{2}{3}} </imath>.

~Pinotation

(Other solutions weren't explicit with logic).

==Solution 2==
Since <imath>\sqrt{81} = 9</imath> and <imath>\sqrt{16} = 4</imath>, we can simplify this expression to <imath>\frac{\sqrt{16\cdot 9}}{\sqrt{81\cdot 4}} = \frac{\sqrt{144}}{\sqrt{324}}</imath>, which can be calculated to be <imath>\frac{12}{18} = \boxed{ \textbf{(B) } \frac{2}{3}}</imath>.

~OlympiadMaster

==Solution 3==
<imath>\frac{\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}}{\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}}=\frac{4\sqrt{\sqrt{81}}}{9\sqrt{\sqrt{16}}}=\frac{4\times3}{9\times2}=\frac{12}{18}=\frac23</imath>, so our answer is <imath>\boxed{ \textbf{(B) } \frac{2}{3}}</imath>.

~Yuhao2012

==Solution 4==
<imath>\frac{\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}}{\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}}=\frac{\sqrt{16\cdot9}}{\sqrt{81\cdot4}}</imath> Notice that <imath>16=4^2</imath>, <imath>9=3^2</imath>, <imath>81=9^2</imath>, and <imath>4=2^2</imath>. We also know that <imath>x^2 y^2 = (xy)^2</imath>. 
So this equals <imath>\frac{\sqrt{4^2\cdot3^2}}{\sqrt{9^2\cdot2^2}}=\frac{\sqrt{(4\cdot3)^2}}{\sqrt{(9\cdot2)^2}}=\frac{\sqrt{12^2}}{\sqrt{18^2}}=\frac{12}{18}=\frac{2}{3}</imath>, so our answer is <imath>\boxed{ \textbf{(B) } \frac{2}{3}}</imath>.

~ppatruni2013 from Carnage MS

==Solution 5==
Since <imath>\sqrt[3]{81} = 3</imath>, and <imath>\sqrt{16} = 4</imath>, the numerator of <imath>\frac{\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}}{\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}}</imath> becomes <imath>4 \cdot 3 = 12</imath>. To find the denominator's value, we know that <imath>\sqrt[3]{16} = 2</imath>, and that <imath>\sqrt{81} = 9</imath>, the denominator of <imath>\frac{\sqrt{16\sqrt{81}}}{\sqrt{81\sqrt{16}}}</imath> yields <imath> 9 \cdot 2 = 18</imath>. We are left with <imath>\frac{12}{18}</imath>. After further simplification, our answer is <imath>\boxed{ \textbf{(B) } \frac{2}{3}}</imath>.
~Ingeniouspeacock36
